S&C’s mission is to build upon our legacy of caring for team members, excellence in customer service and operations, and technology leadership to deliver innovative solutions for a safer, reliable, resilient electrical grid. 

Fulfilling our vision to create an outage-free, sustainable electrical energy future relies upon the talent, passion, and dedication of each of our valued team members.

About S&C

For more than a century, S&C has transformed electricity distribution—from pioneering the Liquid Power Fuse to today’s intelligent automation. Powered by team member expertise and precision engineering, S&C develops technologies that bring intelligent, automated action to more of the distribution grid, strengthening resilience and improving reliability.

At S&C, you'll find opportunities to grow your career, contribute to meaningful work, develop new skills, and help strengthen the resilience and reliability of the electrical grid. Opportunities are available across engineering, manufacturing, skilled trades, field service, and corporate functions. Through training, mentorship, and continuous learning, we support team members in building new skills and expanding their experience.
